name: notveryordinarymahjong
description: Web based Japanese riichi mahjong game (shared rules engine + Colyseus server + React 3D-ish client)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mahjong/shared && npm run build -w @mahjong/server && npm run build -w @mahjong/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @mahjong/server && npm run typecheck -w @mahjong/client
